'''Cargryph Capital Management''' was the name of the partnership between the ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Marn Hierogryph]]. [[Jarael]], [[Demagol|Rohlan Dyre]] and [[Slyssk]] were also members of the Cargryph Capital team.
